content.short: Subbi provides tooling and infrastructure for decentralised crypto-native subscription payments.
content.description: Subbi provides tooling and infrastructure for businesses to accept recurring cryptocurrency payments. It offers a complete toolkit to start subscription payments in under five minutes, including hosted checkouts, a React library, and direct contract integration. Subbi currently supports USDC, with plans to add DAI, USDT, and WETH soon. This enterprise-grade solution enables native recurring crypto payments across Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Multichain networks.
